''See also: [[Iron body Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An [[Iron]] body represents a significant quantitative [[advancement]] in physical capability, elevating an individual to superhuman status compared to those at the [[Copper]] level or below. Achieving this stage involves a refining process that expels impurities from the physical form, though the transformation can be a painful and gruesome ordeal. Because of this refinement, individuals with [[Iron]] bodies possess enhanced durability, such as skin tougher than snake leather, and improved reaction speeds. They also benefit from increased physical strength and the ability to recover more quickly from injuries by using [[madra]] to facilitate healing. There are various specialized types of [[Iron]] bodies that practitioners can train for or acquire. The [[Steelborn body]] is noted for providing immense physical strength, particularly as a user advances to the [[Underlord]] stage. The [[Bloodforged Iron body]] is highly effective at resisting toxins, poisons, and diseases by using [[madra]] to neutralize them. Other variations include the Mountainroot body, which increases stability and weight; the [[Raindrop body]], which aids in agility; the Silverscale body, which offers resistance to spiritual attacks; and the Moonheart body, which can separate a user's consciousness from their physical sensations to maintain mental control during trauma. While an [[Iron]] body provides significant protection, it is not immune to all forms of damage, such as emotional shock or certain specialized attacks.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[The Iron]] body is a physical attribute or stage that accompanies the transition to the [[Iron]] level. Serious [[sacred artists]] typically undergo rigorous body training before they advance to this stage. Once achieved, the [[Iron]] body allows for injuries to heal rapidly into scars. However, those possessing this trait often tend to forget how fragile individuals without such bodies can be. [[Lindon]] is an example of a practitioner who possesses an [[Iron]] body.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|An [[Iron body]] is a physical attribute or stage.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8">''Soulsmith'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Those with [[Iron]] bodies tend to forget the fragility of those without.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c10">''Soulsmith'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The [[Iron body]] allows for rapid healing of injuries into scars.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
